# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(p25cai VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C)
option(P25CAI_SANITIZE "Enable address and undefined-behavior checks" OFF)
option(P25CAI_OPEN25 "Build the existing Open25-DM32 C interface" ON)
add_library(p25cai src/fec.c src/voice.c src/frame.c src/trellis.c src/fields.c src/blocks.c src/packet.c src/control.c src/messages.c src/auth.c)
target_include_directories(p25cai PUBLIC include)
target_compile_features(p25cai PUBLIC c_std_99)
set_target_properties(p25cai PROPERTIES C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
    target_compile_options(p25cai PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    if(P25CAI_SANITIZE)
        target_compile_options(p25cai PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
        target_link_options(p25cai PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined)
    endif()
endif()
if(P25CAI_OPEN25)
    add_library(p25cai_open25 compat/open25/p25.c)
    target_include_directories(p25cai_open25 PUBLIC compat/open25)
    target_link_libraries(p25cai_open25 PUBLIC p25cai)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
        target_compile_options(p25cai_open25 PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    endif()
endif()
include(CTest)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
    add_executable(test_cai tests/test_cai.c)
    target_link_libraries(test_cai PRIVATE p25cai)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
        target_compile_options(test_cai PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME cai COMMAND test_cai)
    add_executable(test_packet tests/test_packet.c)
    target_link_libraries(test_packet PRIVATE p25cai)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
        target_compile_options(test_packet PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME packet COMMAND test_packet)
    add_executable(test_control tests/test_control.c)
    target_link_libraries(test_control PRIVATE p25cai)
    add_test(NAME control COMMAND test_control)
    add_executable(test_messages tests/test_messages.c)
    target_link_libraries(test_messages PRIVATE p25cai)
    add_test(NAME messages COMMAND test_messages)
    add_executable(test_auth tests/test_auth.c)
    target_link_libraries(test_auth PRIVATE p25cai)
    add_test(NAME authentication COMMAND test_auth)
    if(P25CAI_OPEN25)
        add_executable(test_open25 tests/test_open25.c)
        target_link_libraries(test_open25 PRIVATE p25cai_open25)
        add_test(NAME open25 COMMAND test_open25)
    endif()
    find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter)
    if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
        add_test(NAME mathematical_tables COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/generate_golay.py --check)
    endif()
endif()
